description: Single source-of-truth registry for Chris Izworski's Michigan & Great Lakes Field Guides. Used by /guides/, /tools/, and scripts/verify-field-guides.mjs.

guides.title: Michigan Winter Weekend Getaways
guides.subtitle: 12 2-Day Base Towns · Snow Trails + Weather-Proof Backups
guides.summary: Twelve researched Michigan winter weekend bases, from Munising, Marquette and the Keweenaw to Traverse City, Grayling and Detroit, with outdoor itineraries and weather backups.

guides.title: Michigan White Christmas & Christmas-Week Escapes
guides.subtitle: 10 Holiday Base Towns · NOAA 1991–2020 Snow Odds + Backups
guides.summary: Compare 10 Michigan Christmas-week escape towns ranked by NOAA 1991–2020 1-inch snow-depth probability (~96% Marquette to 45.7% Frankenmuth), resort snowmaking insurance, holiday lights, and mild-December backup plans.

guides.title: Michigan First Snow Adventures
guides.subtitle: 12 Early-Winter Snowbelts · Lake-Effect Physics & Grass-Bed Trails
guides.summary: Where winter arrives first in Michigan: 12 high-elevation Lake Superior and Northern Lower snowbelt stops with grass-bed Nordic trail thresholds (2–4" vs. 12"), early snowmaking hills, and bare-ground hike backups.

guides.title: Michigan Late-Fall & November Adventure Guide
guides.subtitle: 12 Shoulder-Season Stops · Swollen Waterfalls, Agates, Steelhead & Migration
guides.summary: 12 researched Michigan late-fall and November destinations for swollen U.P. waterfalls, post-gale Lake Superior agates and Petoskey stones, fall chrome steelhead runs, and sandhill crane/waterfowl staging—with Nov 15–30 firearm deer-season blaze-orange rules.

guides.title: Great Lakes Winter Freighter & Harbor Guide
guides.subtitle: 12 Shoreline Viewing Hubs · Final Lock Push, Layups & Icebreakers
guides.summary: 12 public Great Lakes harbors and lock overlooks for late-season freighter passages, the Jan 15–Mar 25 Soo Locks winter closure, 1,000-footer winter layup berths, and USCG icebreaker operations.

guides.title: Michigan Winter Activities Field Guide
guides.subtitle: 18 Curated Experiences · Snowshoeing, Luge, Waterfalls & Dark Skies
guides.summary: 18 source-backed winter experiences across both peninsulas covering snowshoeing, frozen waterfalls, fat-tire biking, winter wildlife, downhill and XC skiing, Muskegon luge, and dark-sky stargazing.

guides.title: Frozen Michigan: Ice Caves, Waterfalls & Shorelines
guides.subtitle: 11 Winter Ice Wonders · Formation Evidence & Safe Shore Access
guides.summary: Eleven Michigan winter viewpoints, including Eben Ice Caves, Pictured Rocks ice curtains, Tahquamenon and Bond Falls, and Lake Michigan shorelines, with access notes and cold-trend handoffs.

guides.title: Michigan Winter Trails: Snowshoe, XC Ski & Fat-Bike Loops
guides.subtitle: 15 Trail Systems · 50 Named Loops · Track Etiquette & Plow Rules
guides.summary: 15 audited Michigan winter trail systems and 50 named DNR/NPS loops with snowshoe vs. groomed ski track etiquette, Silver Lake's Dec 15–Mar 15 fat-bike season, and seasonal unplowed road warnings.

guides.title: Northern Michigan Wine, Cider & Spirits
guides.subtitle: 18 Anchor Venues + 102-Venue Crosswalk · Heated Igloos & Fireside Flights
guides.summary: 18 anchor wineries, heritage cideries, and craft distilleries across Old Mission, Leelanau, Traverse City, and Petoskey/Walloon Lake—with heated winter domes, vineyard snowshoe loops, and 5:00 PM distillery handoffs.

guides.title: The Great Lakes Rockhound’s Field Guide
guides.subtitle: 15 Agate, Petoskey Stone, Yooperlite & Fossil Beaches
guides.summary: 15 audited Great Lakes beaches with stone ID diagnostics, gravel-bar anatomy, 365nm filtered UV specs for Yooperlites, live 72-hour wave-worked badges, and the boundary between Michigan's 25-lb state limit and National Lakeshore collecting bans.

guides.title: The Great Lakes Island-Hopper's Field Guide
guides.subtitle: 12 Ferry-Access Archipelagos · Personality Matrix & Open-Water Rules
guides.summary: 12 audited Great Lakes ferry-access archipelagos with open-water nautical miles, crossing physics, vehicle and bike regulations, canine biosecurity bans, and direct ferry booking handoffs.

guides.title: Michigan Spring Awakening & Forager’s Field Guide
guides.subtitle: 12 Seasonal Milestones · Morels, Sugarbushes, Ephemerals & Vernal Choruses
guides.summary: Northwoods field naturalist & phenology guide to Michigan spring: morels, maple tapping, vernal pool amphibian choruses, trillium blankets, and 41.7°N to 47.4°N soil warming waves.

guides.title: Ghost Ships & Clear Water: Great Lakes Shipwreck Viewing Field Guide
guides.subtitle: 12 Shallow Preserves · Kayak, Glass-Bottom Boat, Snorkel & Dune Viewing
guides.summary: Maritime historian & underwater preserve ranger guide to 12 shallow Great Lakes shipwrecks in 5 to 25 feet of crystal-clear water visible by kayak, glass-bottom boat, snorkel, or beach walking.

guides.title: Michigan After Dark: The Northern Lights, Dark-Sky Preserves & Meteor Shower Field Guide
guides.subtitle: 12 Dark-Sky Preserves & Aurora Shorelines · Horizon Azimuths, Bortle Ratings & Night Etiquette
guides.seasonLabel: Year-Round · Peak Aurora Sep–Apr · Perseids Aug
guides.summary: 12 audited Michigan dark-sky preserves and Great Lakes shorelines with horizon azimuth compasses, Bortle ratings, 24/7 gate access rules, and smartphone night-mode cheat sheets.

guides.title: Holy Waters & Cedar Bottoms: Michigan’s Blue-Ribbon River Paddling & Fly-Fishing Field Guide
guides.subtitle: 14 Curated Floats · Live USGS CFS Flow Badges, USFS Permits & Livery Shuttles
guides.seasonLabel: May–Oct · Peak Paddling & Dry Fly Hatches
guides.summary: 14 curated half-day and overnight river floats across the Au Sable, Manistee, Pere Marquette, Pine, Jordan, and Two Hearted rivers with live USGS CFS flow badges, USFS permit rules, and livery shuttles.
